description: Build a meeting prep brief for 1-12 attendees: how to communicate with and persuade each person, and which pairings in the room need care. Name attendees or pass a department. Read-only; costs 2 units.

department.description: Use everyone tagged with this department instead of naming members. Exact match first; refuses and asks for names if more than 12 people match or the name spans several departments.

goal.description: Optional meeting goal, e.g. 'agree the Q4 roadmap', used to tailor the advice.

members.description: Profile ids or full names of attendees (1-12). Omit when using department.

name: prep_meeting

people.description: How to work with each attendee.

weakest_pair.description: The pairing with the lowest score.

title: Prepare for a meeting
